_comment: Sample seed for 2 attributes (Riya and Sabr) out of the 200. Full file in assets/data/attributes_seed.json (~5 000 lines).
_source: 200-Attributes.xlsx (source of truth) and NafsMutmainna-200-Attributes.docx (narrative guide); cross-referenced with HeartOS/01_core_tables/attributes.md and HeartOS/07_appendices/200_attributes.md
_authentication_standard: Quran references verified against the Mushaf; Hadith references cite recognised collections (Sahih Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Jami at-Tirmidhi, Sunan Abu Dawud, Sunan Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad, Shuab al-Iman). See HeartOS/GLOSSARY.md §'Hadith authentication' for the full standard.
_known_issues: The 200 attribute detail section in 07_appendices/200_attributes.md has cosmetic field-alignment issues in the Prophetic_Dua_* fields (Urdu/Arabic text swaps in some entries). These are rendering issues, not content issues — the underlying references in this seed are authentic. Fix scheduled for v1.1. See AUDIT_REPORT.md §3.3.

attributes.Definition: Seeking people's praise and recognition through acts intended for Allah.
attributes.Practical_Understanding: Riya grows when people's approval becomes more important than Allah's pleasure.

attributes.Definition: Restraint of the self from anxiety and haste; perseverance in obedience; calm in the face of hardship.
attributes.Practical_Understanding: Patience is the believer's weapon — it is half of faith, the other half being gratitude.
